description: This file defines a QWidget subclass 'SubjectsPad' for a GUI component in the BORIS software, used to display and interact with subjects in a grid layout, including event handling and signal emission.

classes.name: SubjectsPad
classes.description: A QWidget subclass that displays subjects in a grid, allowing interaction and event handling.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A QWidget containing a QPushButton, used within SubjectsPad for each subject.

methods.name: compose
methods.description: Creates the grid of subject buttons based on filtered subjects.

methods.name: addWidget
methods.description: Adds a button widget for a subject at specified grid position.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Emits a signal when a subject button is clicked.

methods.name: eventFilter
methods.description: Handles key press events to forward to main window.

methods.name: closeEvent
methods.description: Emits signal to save widget geometry on close.
